propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family sub-seam layer between core and adapter, the two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel), and the shared-jira provenance decision with its deployment disambiguation by RemoteRef.instance.

The declared TicketTransport protocol (six members) is incomplete; the reconciler reaches for twenty-one distinct members, with twelve absent from DC transport and undeclared on any Protocol, causing silent failures and runtime crashes despite passing contract suite tests.

RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code and exists only as a frozen dataclass with test helpers, so must be documented as intended design with the gap named and tracked, not as existing deployment distinction.

The jira-datacenter extra introduces rebar's first third-party runtime dependency (pycontribs/jira) gated to an extra, with DC read-only horizon at 28 March 2029 requiring explicit time-boxing documentation for maintenance decisions.

User-guide documentation must state DC least-privilege expectations (dedicated PAT scoped to reconciled projects only), security properties (JIRA_PAT environment-only, allow_insecure as cleartext-only-if-you-must, ca_bundle for internal CAs), and configuration for non-standard workflows (resolved_statuses).

Three sites in ADR 0035 falsely assert the first real second backend is out of scope (diagram comment :111, prose :204-205, Decision :236-237), all falsified by this epic landing DC ahead of the reserved GitHub adapter, requiring all three corrected plus annotation of section (c).
